dsn.title: Connection string
dsn.description: A sqlserver:// URL, or an ADO or ODBC connection string, naming the database to write, such as sqlserver://user:password@host:1433?database=warehouse&encrypt=true. Without encrypt=true or strict, the server's certificate isn't verified.

schema.title: Schema
schema.description: The schema to write to when the pipeline names no namespace. It's created if it's missing.
